author: Scott Manley
description:
ULA's Vulcan rocket has suffered a second ascent anomaly as a solid booster made by Northrop Grumman burned through and lost the nozzle, the mission appears to have recovered.

NASASpaceFlight Coverage here:

title: Vulcan Rocket Blows Out Another Booster!
